board_changed: The board changed. Reload it and try again.
board_full: This board is full. Finish or move some tasks first.
boards_full: You have as many boards as you can. Delete one first.
board_columns_full: A board can’t have more columns.
last_column_of_kind: A board keeps at least one column of each kind.
managed_in_jira: This board is managed in Jira. Make this change there.
reconnect_jira: Reconnect Jira in Settings › Connectors to keep this board in sync.
first_sync: Wait for the first sync with Jira to finish.
connect_jira_first: Connect Jira in Settings › Connectors first.
jira_board_unavailable: That Jira board isn’t available to your Jira account.
jira_board_synced: This Jira board is already synced.
not_jira_board: Only boards synced with Jira can be synced.
jira_not_incoming: Jira boards show Jira issues only. Pick a board kept in the app.
jira_unsupported: Jira keeps this for Jira issues. Open the issue in Jira to change it.
workspace_task_copy: Workspace tasks can’t be duplicated here. Add a task in the workspace instead.
task_not_deletable: Only the person who added this task and the workspace admins can delete it.
validation_error: Something in the request isn’t right. Reload the page and try again.
name_too_long: That name is too long. Use a shorter one.
title_too_long: That title is too long. Use a shorter one.
description_too_long: The description is too long. Shorten it.
comment_too_long: The comment is too long. Shorten it.
range_invalid: The start can’t be after the due date.
recurrence_invalid: Pick at least one day of the week.
subtasks_full: A task can’t have more subtasks.
not_comment_author: Only the comment’s author can change it.
attachments_full: A task can’t have more attachments.
cover_not_image: Only an image can be a cover.
sticker_not_on_board: This field isn’t on the board.
system_sticker: Built-in fields can be hidden, not removed.
board_stickers_full: A board can’t have more fields.
stickers_full: You have as many fields as you can. Delete one first.
states_full: A field can’t have more states.
value_kind_mismatch: That value doesn’t fit this field.
upload_not_claimable: The upload didn’t finish. Attach the file again.
upload_too_large: That file is too large to attach.
storage_limit: There’s no storage left for this. Free up space or upgrade.
storage_not_included: Your plan doesn’t include storage for files.
